campaign.title: Environmental Heatwave & PM2.5 Surge
campaign.question: Do satellite PM2.5 spikes and heat-index thresholds predict acute asthma ER admissions across held-out rural districts?

1.name: The Rumour Dungeon
1.evidence: Forums, social symptom trends, raw search spikes, pharmacy chatter
1.trap: Exogenous panic and small-n clusters: media coverage spikes searches while transmission is flat.
1.rule: D_L1 = 12 x max(0, FAAR - 1) + 18 x rho_n

2.name: The Forgotten Archives
2.evidence: Preprints, single-centre cohorts, unadjusted environmental data
2.trap: Seasonal and demographic confounding: winter, school terms and dilution create spurious links.

3.name: The Temple of Replication
3.trap: Lag-dredging and spatial overfitting: search enough lags and one fits; urban fits fail rural.
3.rule: D_L3 = 25 x I(p_raw < .05 and p_corr > .05) + min(20, 5 ln K) + min(25, 20 x max(0, G_spatial))

4.name: The Citadel of Truth
4.evidence: Official registries as they stood on each decision day (vintages)
4.trap: Backfill leakage and baseline failure: finalized numbers were not known in real time.
4.rule: D_chrono = 35 x I_unreleased + min(25, round(40 x max(0, delta_vintage))); D_final by surge skill

FACT_CHECK.name: Fact Check
FACT_CHECK.effect: Purges media-spike weeks and flags small-n claims as exploratory: M = 0.20 for Rule 1.

MEDIA_DENOISE.name: Media De-Noising Filter
MEDIA_DENOISE.effect: Regresses news volume out of the signal, turning it into a media-adjusted index for every later level.

EXPLORATORY_CLAIM.name: Exploratory Claim
EXPLORATORY_CLAIM.effect: Declares the claim exploratory: cheap, weak cover, M = 0.50 for Rule 1.

BIAS_DETECTION.name: Bias Detection
BIAS_DETECTION.effect: Puts the confounder Z in the model before the attack: omega = 0 and +5 HP for rigour.

PREREGISTER.name: Preregister
PREREGISTER.effect: Locks one biologically grounded lag before testing: K = 1, so p_corr = p_raw.

REPLICATION_SHIELD.name: Replication Shield
REPLICATION_SHIELD.effect: Shrinks the signal's weights (ridge, tuned by time-blocked CV in the home region) so they transfer.

TEMPORAL_GUARD.name: Temporal Guard
TEMPORAL_GUARD.effect: Point-in-time masking plus a reporting-delay nowcast: trains on vintages, no 35 HP leak penalty.

ABLATION_STRIKE.name: Ablation Strike
ABLATION_STRIKE.effect: Drops every signal that does not lower error on a validation slice of the training period.

score_rules.traps: 0.25 x 100 x traps falsified / traps faced
score_rules.efficiency: 0.15 x min(100, 100 x ablation lift % / max(10, credits spent))

verdicts.VALIDATED: Beat the AR(4) baseline at surge onset on unseen, real-time data, and the gain is unlikely to be luck (Diebold-Mariano p < 0.05).
verdicts.NOT BETTER: Survived, but did not beat the hospital-only baseline on unseen real-time data.
verdicts.BASELINE: The benchmark itself: AR(4) plus a seasonal harmonic on admissions alone.

evidence.text: Beat the AR(4) baseline at surge onset on 104 unseen real-time days: SS = +0.32, Diebold-Mariano p = 0.0014.
Overall real-time error 25% lower than the baseline (ablation lift).
No leakage: real-time error within 1% of hindsight.
Replicated across 4 held-out regions: worst-case error growth G = 0.71.
Survives its search: K = 1, p_raw = 4.2e-21, Sidak p_corr = 4.2e-21.
Not a seasonal artefact: partial r = +0.93 after adjusting for season and temperature (omega = 0.00).

misleading.text: Vex (Searches, smoke complaints, app opens and AQI monitors, at any lag from 1 to 21 days, predict asthma admissions.): hardest hit by vintage leakage (60 HP), and fell.
Quill (A single-district study (n = 24): pollen counts predict asthma surges two weeks early.): hardest hit by no surge-onset skill (50 HP).

brief.uncertainty: Skill is measured on 104 surge-onset days in one region's holdout; rural transfer is weaker (G = 0.71). Re-check each season with fresh vintages.
brief.truth: PM2.5 drives asthma admissions two days later, more weakly in rural districts. Searches and posts follow news coverage and season. Regulatory AQI is accurate but published days late. Pollen leads by one day, not fourteen.
